actScams.intro: Read each message and make the call. If it’s a scam, tap the words that give it away.
actScams.question: Is this message safe, or is it a scam?
actScams.tapWords: Now tap the words that give it away. Found {n} of {t}.
actScams.todo: don’t click or reply. Show a trusted adult, then block and delete.
actScams.sys: Shown to an adult. Blocked and deleted.
actScams.hint: Look again. Which words feel off?
actScams.slowDown: When a message makes you feel rushed, excited or scared, slow down.
actScams.wrap: Pause. Real messages rarely need an answer in minutes. Don’t click. Open the real app yourself. Show an adult. Asking is the smart move.

ms.b: CONGRATS!! You won a free GameStation 5. Claim [in the next 10 min]: [gs5-prizes.win/claim]. Just [pay $4.99 shipping with a parent’s card].
k: A countdown meant to rush you
A strange web address
A real prize never makes you pay. This also asks for a card number.

ms.b: yo i can give u [10,000 free coins]. send me ur [login + password] and i’ll load them rn
k: Free in-game money is a common trick
No real player or game needs your password. Sharing it can cost you the whole account.

ms.b: Practice ends at 5. I’ll pick you up by the front doors. Text me if it runs late.
ms.y: It’s from a saved contact, matches plans you know about, and asks for nothing.
ms.r: Ok. See you at the front doors.

ms.b: Your account will be [DELETED in 1 hour]. Verify now to keep your photos: [g00gle-support.co/verify]
k: Zeros where letters should be
A scary deadline
A login link. Open the real app instead.

ms.b: Reminder: 2 books are due Friday. You can renew them in the app.
ms.y: It appears inside an app you already use, only shares information, and lets you act in the app.
ms.s: You renewed both books in the library app.

ms.b: hey its your cousin, [got a new number]. can u buy 2 [gift cards] and send me the codes? [don’t tell anyone] i’ll pay u back
k: Claims to be family from a new number
Gift card codes are a favorite scam payment
Asking you to keep a secret is a red flag

ms.b: hey its tyler, my account got locked. [can u read me the 6 digit code] that just got texted to u? [need it rn] pls pls
k: That code is the key to your account. Never share it, even with a friend.
A friend in a big hurry is a pressure trick. Call or ask them in person.

ms.b: Your package could not be delivered. [Pay a $1.99 fee] at [pkg-redelivery.help/track] or it will be [sent back today].
k: Real delivery companies don’t ask for a fee by text
A strange web address, not the real company’s site
A deadline meant to rush you

ms.b: FREE skins for everyone!! Tap [skinz-free.gg] and [log in with your game account] to get 5. [Only 20 left].
k: A strange link, not the real game store
Free skins don’t need your login. That’s how accounts get stolen.
“Only 20 left” is a rush trick

ms.b: trade u 5 rare skins for ur 1 [dragon skin]. [send yours first] so i know ur real. [trust me], im a top player
k: A trade that’s too good to be true
Making you go first means you can lose your item
“Trust me” is not proof. Real trades happen in the game at the same time.

ms.b: Game moved to Saturday at 10. Same field. Bring water.
ms.y: It’s from a saved contact, it matches your team, and it only shares plans. You can double check with your team.
ms.r: Got it. Saturday at 10. I’ll bring water.

ms.b: Pizza at my house after the game? My mom said it’s ok if your mom says yes.
ms.y: It’s from a friend you know, and it asks you to check with your parent first.
ms.r: Let me ask my mom. I’ll text you back.
